payload: Research early finding: current Thread source uses turnAnchor="top". Current official docs say this defaults autoScroll=false; top anchoring keeps the question/answer start rather than following every new chunk, and topAnchorMessageClamp supports long user questions. I am verifying pinned implementation and observing baseline/public AI Elements alternatives; no product changes.

Promising same-family source discovery: assistant-ui now publishes a Composer Attachments chip design (filename + metadata + trailing remove) at https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements/composer-attachments, and received-files rows under https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements/attachment. These are distinct from baseline tiles and could improve filename identity while retaining foundation. Still need exact source/revision and actual demo observation; I’m pursuing those.
